Create a new Action by entering a new pagetitle for a Action
into the field below.

If you enter an existing Action pagetitle - you will edit the Action
with that pagetitle.

{{{section|Action|level=1|hidden}}}
=Action=
{{{for template|Action|multiple}}}
{| class="wikitable"
! colspan='2' | Action
|-
! purpose:
<!-- Text purpose -->
|{{{field|purpose|property=Action purpose}}}
|-
! servicetype:
<!-- Text servicetype -->
|{{{field|servicetype|property=Action servicetype|input type=radiobutton|mandatory|values=Agent,WikiTask|default=Agent}}}
|-
! service:
<!-- URL service -->
|{{{field|service|property=Action service}}}
|-
! inputtype:
<!-- Text inputtype -->
|{{{field|inputtype|property=Action inputtype|input type=radiobutton|values=Query,Page,URL|default=Page}}}
|-
! input:
<!-- Code input -->
|{{{field|input|property=Action input|input type=textarea|editor=wikieditor|size=300}}}
|-
! actionpage:
<!-- Page actionpage -->
|{{{field|actionpage|property=Action actionpage|default=Property:Action actionpage}}}
|-
! output:
<!-- Code output -->
|{{{field|output|property=Action output|input type=textarea|editor=wikieditor|size=300}}}
|-
! engine:
<!-- Text engine -->
|{{{field|engine|property=Action engine|input type=radiobutton|values=ai,rythm,freemarker|default=rythm}}}
|-
! author:
<!-- Page author -->
|{{{field|author|property=Action author|input type=combobox|values from=namespace=User}}}
|-
! since:
<!-- Date since -->
|{{{field|since|property=Action since|input type=datepicker}}}
|-
! comment:
<!-- Text comment -->
|{{{field|comment|property=Action comment|input type=textarea|editor=wikieditor|size=400}}}
|-
! agent:
<!-- Page agent -->
|{{{field|agent|property=Action agent|input type=combobox|values from=concept=Agent}}}
|-
! name:
<!-- Text name -->
|{{{field|name|property=Action name|mandatory}}}
|-
|-
|}
{{{field|storemode|default=subobject|hidden}}}
